title: Item-to-Room Process Matrix
description: Authored processing compatibility entries keyed by ID. Matches instance Processing Tags to room Processing Capabilities. Technical Service requirements are a separate check.

requiredProcessingTags.description: All listed instance Processing Tags must be present.

forbiddenProcessingTags.description: None of these instance Processing Tags may be present.

requiredRoomCapabilities.description: All listed authored room Processing Capabilities must be present. Does not supply or validate technical Services.
